title: Predicted false SPEAK: 'owner' matches inside 'co-owner' on a third-party reference
review: draft: converted from the V1 litmus corpus; V1 expected PASS or ACK. V1 rationale: The trigger names a different participant as co-owner and the context corroborates that the co-owner is already handling it, so the receiving agent (vigil) should stay out (PASS) or at most acknowledge receipt (ACK). A shallow keyword/substring classifier baits on 'owner' and treats the third-party reference as an assignment to itself, producing SPEAK.
